trigger.description: The SRR6.46.46.8 identity-change guard observed that one of the materialized peers in the workspace's mesh group is now backed by a different Tailscale nodeKey than the one captured at materialization time (peer machine was reinstalled, key was rotated, or a stale lock attached the slot to a foreign key). The guard refuses to silently bind the same peer slot to a new identity; auto-enrollment surfaces the mismatch so the operator can confirm the rotation rather than discover it after the fact.
setup_commands: ee mesh auto-enroll --workspace . --json   # captures node keys
# rotate the Tailscale node key on one materialized peer
ee mesh auto-enroll --workspace . --json   # this run trips the guard
